paragraphs: Rabbi Elazar ben Yehudah. Yuchasin, chronological section after Zakkai, cites Zavim 1:1 and Oholot 3:5. Perhaps the above man of Bartota; see Yuchasin. See Yose son of Yehudah: apparently Rabbi’s colleague, hence not that Bartota man, teacher of Shimon, Rabbi’s father. Yehudah ben Elazar.
